req.title: Player POST accepts nickname optionally
req.statement: The system shall accept POST /players/ payloads without a nickname field and treat nickname as optional.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-040 states that nickname (which maps to no field in the actual schema — the optional fields are middle_name, date_of_birth, abbr_position, team, league, starting11) is optional on POST /players/. More precisely, the requirement means all optional fields in PlayerRequestModel can be omitted. We test: (1) positive — POST with only required fields (first_name, last_name, squad_number, position) and no optional fields, expecting HTTP 201; (2) negative — POST with missing required field (first_name omitted), expecting HTTP 422; (3) boundary — POST with exactly the minimal required payload (squad number at boundary value 27, one above the 26 pre-loaded rows), confirming 201 and that optional fields default to null in the response; (4) decision-table — POST with nickname-equivalent optional fields explicitly set to null vs omitted, both should yield 201; (5) negative path — POST with an empty body, expecting 422. These tests assert exact status codes and exact response field values to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_post_player_without_optional_fields_returns_201
preconditions: Database contains 26 pre-loaded players with squad numbers 1-26
Squad number 99 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with only required fields: first_name, last_name, squad_number=99, position; omit all optional fields
expected: Response body contains id (UUID), firstName, lastName, squadNumber=99, position
Optional fields (middleName, dateOfBirth, abbrPosition, team, league, starting11) are null or absent
trace: R-PLAYER-040: system shall accept POST /players/ without optional fields
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_without_optional_fields_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "TestFirst",
        "lastName": "TestLast",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "TestFirst"
    assert body["lastName"] == "TestLast"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert body["position"] == "Goalkeeper"
    assert body["middleName"] is None
    assert body["dateOfBirth"] is None
    assert body["abbrPosition"] is None
    assert body["team"] is None
    assert body["league"] is None
    assert body["starting11"] is None
    assert "id" in body

test_post_player_without_optional_fields_returns_201()

tests.name: test_post_player_empty_body_returns_422
actions: POST /players/ with an empty JSON object body {}
expected: Response detail indicates missing required fields
trace: R-PLAYER-040: error pathway — empty body missing all required fields yields 422
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_empty_body_returns_422():
    r = client.post("/players/", json={})
    assert r.status_code == 422
    body = r.json()
    assert "detail" in body
    fields_reported = str(body["detail"])
